links.outcome: Decision to screen for suicidal ideation; documented suicide risk assessments
links.effect: Interruptive CDS: 42% (121/289) decisions to screen vs 4% (12/307) non-interruptive (OR 17.7, p<0.001); documented assessments 63/289 vs 11/307 (p<0.001).
links.quote: Adjusting for provider cluster effects, Interruptive CDS led to significantly higher numbers of decisions to screen (42%=121/289 encounters) compared to Non-Interruptive CDS (4%=12/307) (odds ratio=17.7, p-value <0.001).
